'''Big Devil''' is a character who is mentioned in {{SA}}.

==History==
===Background===
Big Devil was a member of the [[Grove Street Families]] who died some time between [[1987]] and [[1992]].

He is mentioned by [[Sweet Johnson]] and buried in the [[Vinewood Cemetery]] alongside fellow Families members [[Little Devil]] and [[Tony (GSF)|Tony]].
